Source.Cleanup: All nine lifecycle/self-matching rules, ten calendar rules and seven queues were removed with absence reads.
Source.Normalization: Native requests, target bindings and bodies are retained. Event IDs are replaced by one shared placeholder per origin. Calendar event times are unchanged; lifecycle events are mapped to an explicit local service-time minute after setup. Setup receipts are drained without asserting native first-invocation jitter. The targetless rule has no direct target in this replay.

Lifecycle.Normalization: Native lifecycle commands use account 123456789012. Pattern-only and empty-schedule replacements are applied to the retained same/life rules with State omitted (the separately captured ENABLED default). Times and the bounded downtime drain are deterministic kernel policy, not a native jitter, historical target-state, or AWS downtime promise. Initial rules are admitted disabled and enabled after their target bindings, so replay does not assert which configuration a native first-invocation race observes.
